_ghi: Nhân vật minh hoạ cho The Myth Behind (viet-myth-behind.mjs): tên trong sổ chuyện (moc[].nhan_vat) → mã thư mục brand/astrolas/nhan-vat/<id>. Mô tả hình là lời vẽ (sáng tạo, không phải lời kể — lời kể vẫn là câu nguyên văn Wikipedia trong từng tệp sao). Nhân vật đã có trong kho (Myths of the Zodiac) chỉ ghi id. ve-nhan-vat.mjs vẽ id nào chưa có PNG (~111₫ / dáng). ve_sau: true = chưa có trong tập Short nào (câu bị gonChuyen cắt) → chưa vẽ.

Cronus.mo_ta: Cronus, the Titan king, a towering stern old man with a long grey beard, dark bronze crown, heavy grey-and-ochre robes, holding a curved golden sickle

Rhea.mo_ta: Rhea, mother of the gods, a gentle noble woman with long dark braided hair, a tower-shaped crown, earthy green and terracotta robes

Gaia.mo_ta: Gaia, the Earth goddess, a calm motherly woman whose long hair is woven with leaves, flowers and vines, a moss-green flowing dress

Uranus.mo_ta: Uranus, the primordial sky god, a tall bearded man in a deep night-blue robe sprinkled with tiny stars, a pale silver halo

Helios.mo_ta: Helios, the sun god, a strong young man with a radiant golden crown of sun rays, golden hair, white tunic with a gold cloak

Phaethon.mo_ta: Phaethon, a bold teenage boy with messy golden hair, a short orange tunic, bright eager eyes, holding chariot reins

Selene.mo_ta: Selene, the moon goddess, a serene young woman with long silver-white hair, a silver crescent moon crown, pale lavender flowing dress

Endymion.mo_ta: Endymion, a handsome young shepherd with dark curly hair, a simple cream tunic and a brown cloak, a wooden shepherd's crook

Hermes.mo_ta: Hermes as a cheeky little boy god, curly brown hair, a small winged cap, tiny winged sandals, a short sky-blue tunic, mischievous grin

Maia.mo_ta: Maia, a kind young mountain nymph mother, long dark hair with small white flowers, a soft pale-blue dress

Apollo.mo_ta: Apollo, a handsome young god with golden curls and a laurel wreath, white chiton with a gold border, holding a golden lyre

Adonis.mo_ta: Adonis, a beautiful young hunter with soft dark curls, a short green tunic, a hunting spear, gentle face

Persephone.mo_ta: Persephone, a young goddess maiden with long chestnut hair crowned with spring flowers, a pale pink and white dress, holding a pomegranate

Demeter.mo_ta: Demeter, goddess of the harvest, a warm motherly woman with golden-wheat hair, a crown of wheat ears, a golden-yellow robe, holding a torch

Hades.mo_ta: Hades, king of the underworld, a tall pale serious man with a short black beard, a dark iron crown, black and deep purple robes, holding a two-pronged staff

Ares.mo_ta: Ares, god of war, a fierce muscular man in a bronze crested helmet and bronze armor, a red cloak, a spear and round shield

Athena.mo_ta: Athena, goddess of wisdom, a calm tall woman in a golden crested helmet, white robe with a bronze breastplate, a spear and a round shield with an owl

Diomedes.mo_ta: Diomedes, a young Greek warrior hero with a short brown beard, bronze helmet with a blue crest, bronze armor, holding a long spear

Poseidon.mo_ta: Poseidon, god of the sea, a powerful bearded man with wild sea-green hair, a coral crown, sea-blue robe, holding a golden trident

Cecrops.mo_ta: Cecrops, the first king of Athens, a wise old king with a white beard and a simple gold crown, a royal blue robe, holding a scepter

Eris.mo_ta: Eris, goddess of strife, a sly woman with wild dark-red hair, a dark crimson dress, a sharp smile, holding a shining golden apple

Paris.mo_ta: Paris, a handsome young Trojan prince shepherd, dark wavy hair, a Phrygian cap, a short orange tunic, holding a golden apple

Helen.mo_ta: Helen, a very beautiful young queen with long golden hair in a delicate veil, a white and pale-gold gown, a small gold diadem

Aegipan.mo_ta: Aegipan, a friendly goat-legged woodland spirit with small curved horns, shaggy brown fur on the legs, a cheerful face, holding a reed pipe

Lilith.mo_ta: Lilith, a proud independent woman with long black flowing hair, a dark midnight-blue robe fully covering her, calm determined eyes

Adam.mo_ta: Adam, the first man, a simple young man with brown hair and a short beard, a plain wrapped tunic of leaves and cloth

Three angels.mo_ta: three angels flying side by side, white robes, large white feathered wings, soft golden halos, gentle serious faces

Centaurs.mo_ta: a small band of three wild centaurs, men from the waist up with shaggy hair and beards, horse bodies below, galloping, holding clubs
